title: Hair Loss Treatment in Dubai | SOLAR
descr: Hair loss treatment in Dubai at a licensed clinic in Sobha Hartland. Scalp diagnostics, mesotherapy, exosome therapy, LED. Free doctor's consultation.

hero.9: Scalp and hair · doctor-supervised · Dubai (Sobha Hartland)
hero.8: Hair Loss Treatment in Dubai (Sobha Hartland) - Density, Scalp Health and Hair You Stop Losing
hero.7: We work with early and moderate hair fall: diffuse shedding, thinning hair, falling density and an irritated scalp. Diagnostics first, then a course built for your case: scalp mesotherapy, exosome therapy with Dermapen and LED light therapy. If your case needs a different route, we will say so honestly.
hero.0: 30-60 minutes per session, no downtime, back to your day straight after.

what.10: Hair loss treatment is not one procedure but a course.
what.9: First the doctor finds out why the hair is falling, then works on the environment the hair grows in: blood supply to the follicle, the condition of the scalp and the nutrients the growth phase needs. Hair grows in cycles, so the aim of a course is to move more follicles back into the active phase and keep them there.
what.6: Hair grows out of skin. Inflammation, excess sebum, flaking or dryness weaken the follicle long before you notice thinning, and this is where treatment starts.
what.3: Scalp mesotherapy delivers vitamins, amino acids and trace elements directly into the skin around the follicle, where a tablet or a shampoo simply does not reach in that concentration.
what.1: A signal to the growth phase
what.0: Exosome therapy and low-level light therapy work on the signalling environment of the follicle, supporting the shift from the resting phase back to growth.

benefits.13: Why a structured course beats another bottle of anti hair fall shampoo.
benefits.10: The course starts with an examination of the scalp and a conversation about your health, so the plan matches your type of hair loss instead of a general protocol.
benefits.7: Shedding usually calms down before new growth is visible. That is the honest sequence, and it is the first sign the course is working.
benefits.3: Sessions take 30 to 60 minutes, hair can be washed the next day and nothing about your week has to change.
benefits.1: An honest verdict at the consultation
benefits.0: If your hair loss has gone past what our methods can change, we will tell you at the free consultation rather than sell you a course.

whyTitle.1: Hair loss has causes, and they are not all on the scalp
whyTitle.0: Hair is one of the first things to react to what happens in the body, so treating only the surface rarely holds.

whyCards.10: Find the cause before the course
whyCards.9: Thyroid and hormonal shifts, iron, ferritin and vitamin D deficiency, a strict diet, illness or a stressful few months, and in Dubai also hard water, chlorine and constant air conditioning. The doctor will ask about all of it and may recommend blood tests before starting.
whyCards.6: A close examination of the scalp shows the state of the skin, the sebum balance, inflammation and how dense the hair actually is between the visible parting and the rest of the head. HELEO4 LED therapy is used here both to assess the scalp and as part of the treatment.
whyCards.3: The hair cycle is measured in months, not weeks. A realistic course is 6 to 8 sessions, and the result is judged at around three months, with maintenance afterwards. Anyone promising new hair in two weeks is selling something else.
whyCards.0: With pronounced androgenetic alopecia, a receding hairline or visible bald areas, the follicle is no longer there to support, and the method of choice becomes a hair transplant. We do not perform hair transplants or PRP. If that is your case, we will say so at the consultation and you will not spend money on a course that cannot deliver.

evTitle.0: The methods we use are studied in dermatology, though the evidence differs in strength for each of them.

evCards.12: Clinical studies of scalp mesotherapy with vitamin and amino acid cocktails report reduced shedding and improved hair density in people with diffuse hair loss, while noting that protocols differ between studies and larger controlled trials are still needed.
evCards.7: Research into exosome preparations for hair growth is recent: pilot clinical studies and case series describe improvement in hair density and thickness, and the field is moving towards larger controlled trials.
evCards.2: Randomized controlled trials of low-level light therapy for pattern hair loss show an increase in hair count compared with sham devices, with a good safety profile and effect that depends on regular, repeated sessions.
evCards.0: The studies refer to the methods, not to a specific clinic. Results are individual and depend on the type of hair loss, its cause and how far it has progressed.

indTitle.0: From diffuse shedding to scalp health and prevention.

indItems.6: Recovery after stress and frequent flights
indItems.3: Prevention when hair loss runs in the family
indItems.0: Diagnosed alopecia is always assessed by the doctor first: some forms need medical treatment or a different method entirely. How the method works in detail: Mesotherapy in Dubai.

steps.13: The doctor examines the scalp and hair, asks about health, medication, diet and stress, and decides whether blood tests are needed before treatment.
steps.9: A close look at the scalp and hair shafts: skin condition, sebum, inflammation, density in the affected zone against a control zone. This is the baseline everything is measured against later.
steps.5: Scalp mesotherapy, Dermapen exosome therapy or LED sessions, alone or combined, usually every one to two weeks. Each session takes 30 to 60 minutes.
steps.1: At around three months the doctor compares the scalp with the baseline and agrees a maintenance schedule with you.
steps.0: Good to know: do not wash your hair for 24 hours after a scalp session, skip sauna, pool and intense sport for a day, and avoid aggressive colouring in the days around a session.

priceTitle.0: The price depends on the method and the number of sessions in your course, and is confirmed at the free doctor's consultation. Message us on WhatsApp.

results.6: The scalp calms down first: less itching, less flaking, a more balanced feel. Shedding often starts to slow around this point.
results.3: Short new hairs appear along the parting and at the temples. This is when the doctor compares the scalp with the baseline and judges the course.
results.0: Density and hair quality keep improving while the course continues. Hair loss is a chronic process, so maintenance sessions are what hold the result.

contra.14: Active infection or inflammation of the scalp
contra.11: Open wounds, fresh scratches or unhealed skin in the treatment area
contra.8: Blood clotting disorders or anticoagulant therapy
contra.5: Oncological disease and treatment in progress
contra.2: Allergy to the components of the preparation

faq: How soon will I see a result?

The scalp feels better within the first month and shedding usually slows within 4 to 6 weeks. Visible density takes 2 to 3 months, because that is how long the hair cycle needs. Judge the course at three months, not at the third session.
How many sessions do I need?

Usually 6 to 8 sessions, every one to two weeks, followed by maintenance. The exact number and the cost of the course are agreed at the free consultation and depend on the cause and how long the hair has been falling.
Will this help if I already have bald patches?

Honestly, no. Our methods support follicles that are still alive: they work on density, hair quality and scalp health. Where the hairline has receded or the scalp shows through, the follicle is gone and no injection brings it back. In that situation the method of choice is a hair transplant, and the doctor will tell you so directly.
Do you do hair transplants or PRP?

No. SOLAR does not perform hair transplants and does not offer PRP. We work with early and moderate hair loss, with hair density and with scalp health, and we will tell you at the consultation if your case needs something we do not do.
What should I do at home between sessions?

Wash your hair as often as it needs, with a gentle shampoo and a filter or softener if your water is hard. Avoid tight styling and hot tools, correct any deficiency the blood tests show, and give it protein and sleep. Home care will not replace the course, but neglecting it can cancel it out.
What is the price of hair loss treatment in Dubai?
The price depends on the zones, the protocol and the number of sessions you need. It is agreed at the free consultation with the doctor, before anything is booked, and there are no hidden extras.

How much does hair loss treatment cost in Dubai?

At SOLAR in Dubai the cost of hair loss treatment depends on the method, the number of sessions and whether protocols are combined. The doctor proposes a course after examining your scalp, and the full cost is agreed at the free consultation, before anything is booked.

  • Dermapen Exosomes ASCE, hair. The strongest single protocol we offer for density and hair quality.
  • Scalp mesotherapy. A course of 6 to 8 sessions is the usual plan for diffuse shedding.
  • Dermapen Genosys Mesotherapy. The price for the scalp is confirmed at the consultation.
  • Scalp diagnostics. Included when you come for the free doctor's consultation.

What changes the price

  • Method: exosome protocols cost more per session than a standard mesotherapy cocktail.
  • Number of sessions: hair loss is treated in courses, and a course is quoted as a whole, not session by session.
  • Combination: mesotherapy plus LED in one visit is usually more economical than two separate visits.
  • Maintenance: after the main course sessions become rarer, so the yearly cost drops.

There are no hidden extras: the consultation is free and the full cost of the course is agreed with you before the first session.

Hair loss treatment near you

The clinic is in Sobha Hartland, Mohammed Bin Rashid City - 220 m from the bus stop and with free parking, so it is an easy drive from most of central Dubai:

Sobha Hartland - on site · Business Bay - ~10 min · Downtown Dubai - ~12 min · Dubai Creek Harbour - ~12 min · Meydan - ~8 min · Ras Al Khor - ~10 min · Al Jaddaf - ~10 min

Message us on WhatsApp and we will suggest a time that fits your route.
